description: Fork of exp297 with every q/k/v/out_proj PermutationalLut replaced by BitPermutationLUT + BitPermutationLUTOptimizer (fp8 latent + fp8 moments Adam). Embeddings, LayerNorms, RankAttention scale, and unembedder remain on regular Adam. Borda projection added after q_perm/k_perm/out_proj since BitPermutationLUT only emits dominance.
